overview: By seven the sheet had eleven new lines. She is asking the day to be done so that night will come. You did not write a dawn. You did not write anything to send.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Wrote the eleven lines, and did not copy them fair, and did not send them.

assets.name: Verona
assets.disposition: Put eleven lines on her sheet

summary: Put eleven lines on her sheet
